title: Polite Trespass
summary: Takemura asks you to talk your way into a closed corporate garden in Vista del Rey, to stand under a cherry tree for five minutes.
description: Takemura wants to see the cherry tree in a closed corporate garden in Vista del Rey, and he wants to see it politely. He asks V to do the talking.

start.bringUp: Takemura proposes a cherry tree in a closed corporate garden, which he would like to see politely.

spot.name: the closed garden terrace in Vista del Rey

g1.asks: What is the last place you were unwelcome and stayed anyway?
g1.know: The corporate guard is watching you and Takemura under the cherry tree.

variations.know: The cherry tree is bare, and the terrace is cold.
The guard refuses at first, and you have to talk your way in.
A second guard is at the gate, and he does not bow.
variations.wants: The first guard to stay on your side.

stages.label: V and Takemura stand under the cherry tree
stages.objective: Stand under the cherry tree with Takemura in Vista del Rey
stages.know: You are on the closed garden terrace in Vista del Rey with Takemura. A corporate guard has let you stay under the tree for five minutes.
stages.wants: V to stay under the tree and be polite.

done.memory: You talked your way into a closed corporate garden in Vista del Rey, and stood under a cherry tree while the guard brought you both tea.

stood-up.memory: You did not come to the corporate garden, and Takemura walked past the closed gate alone.
